Property.Name: mipi-sdca-function-expansion-subsystem-id
Property.Description: This Property shall contain a Subsystem ID to be used to determine the correct Function Expansion Driver to be installed/loaded.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-function-expansion-subsystem-revision-id
Property.Description: This Property shall contain a Subsystem Revision ID to be used to determine the correct Function Expansion Driver to be installed/loaded.

Property.Name: mid-*
Property.Description: This Property shall contain vendor-specific Property information. The vendor may use this Property to add any desired vendor-specific Properties to this Descriptor. Note: This is the only SDCA Descriptor that permits the Vendor to include implementation-defined Properties.
